metaDescription: Order custom Good Value luggage ID tags for bulk branding. Perfect for promotional giveaways and corporate gifts.
introHtml: Good Value luggage ID tags offer a budget-friendly way to keep your brand visible during travel. Made from durable plastic with a clear window for business cards, these tags are ideal for trade shows, employee gifts, or customer appreciation. Choose from multiple colors and add your logo with full-color imprinting for a professional look that won't break your budget.
